# BananaSplit

> Split expenses with friends. The expense tracking layer for humans and AI agents.

BananaSplit tracks shared expenses across vacations, roommates, couples, and group events. Data syncs across iOS, Android, web, and CLI.

## Quick Start

Install CLI:
```
curl -fsSL https://github.com/teotti/banana-cli/releases/latest/download/install.sh | sh
```

Sign in:
```
banana login
```

Check balances:
```
banana balance
```

## CLI Commands

### Balances
- `banana balance` — show aggregate balance (what you owe / are owed)
- `banana balance users` — show balance per person
- `banana balances` — alias for balance users

### Expenses
- `banana expenses list` — list recent expenses
- `banana expenses list --group "Trip"` — filter by group
- `banana expenses list --limit 20` — limit results
- `banana expenses add --title "Dinner" --amount 42 --currency EUR --paid-by me --split me=21 --split Ana=21` — add expense
- `banana expenses add --title "Rent" --amount 1200 --currency USD --split-type equal` — split equally
- `banana expenses get <id>` — show expense details
- `banana expenses edit <id> --amount 50` — edit expense
- `banana expenses delete <id>` — delete expense
- `banana expenses restore <id>` — restore deleted expense

### Recurring Expenses
- `banana recurring list` — list recurring rules
- `banana recurring add --title "Rent" --amount 1200 --frequency monthly` — create recurring expense
- `banana recurring edit <id> --pause` — pause a recurring rule
- `banana recurring delete <id>` — delete rule

### Payments
- `banana payments add --amount 20 --currency EUR --from me --to Ana` — record payment
- `banana payments add --amount 50 --from Ana --to me --description "Settle up"` — payment with note
- `banana payments restore <id>` — restore deleted payment

### Groups
- `banana groups` — list groups
- `banana groups create --name "Lisbon trip" --currency EUR --type travel` — create group
- `banana groups get "Trip"` — show group details
- `banana groups members "Trip"` — list members
- `banana groups activities "Trip"` — show activity feed

### Other
- `banana friends` — list friends
- `banana currencies` — list available currencies
- `banana me` — show authenticated user
- `banana doctor` — health check (CLI, login, skill)

## Output Formats

- Default: human-readable tables
- `--json` — structured JSON for agents
- `--raw` — complete API response

Example:
```
banana balance --json
```

## Naming

Use names instead of IDs:
- `--paid-by Ana` instead of `--paid-by USER_ID`
- `--group "Lisbon trip"` or `--group Lisbon` (prefix match)
- `--currency EUR` or `--currency Euro`
- `me` always refers to the authenticated user

## Agent Integration

Install skill for AI agents:
```
banana skill install
```

Supported agents: Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, Gemini CLI, opencode.

Example prompts:
- "Check my BananaSplit balances"
- "Add a €42 dinner expense split equally with Ana"
- "Show expenses in the Lisbon trip group"
- "Record a $20 payment from me to John"
- "Create a new group called Weekend Trip with EUR currency"
- "List my recurring expenses"

## MCP Server

URL: `https://api.bananasplit.net/mcp`

Connect AI clients (Claude Desktop, Cursor, ChatGPT) directly via Model Context Protocol. OAuth authentication via browser.

Available tools: list_balances, list_expenses, add_expense, add_payment, list_groups, create_group, list_friends.

## Key Concepts

- **Balance**: Net amount owed between you and others
- **Expense**: Shared cost split among people
- **Payment**: Settlement transaction to reduce balance
- **Group**: Container for expenses (travel, home, couple, event)
- **Split**: How an expense divides (equal or custom amounts)
- **Recurring**: Expense that repeats on schedule
